displayName: Native shell with React Native UI islands
statusNote: The native shell owns List, Selection, navigation, state, persistence and stream processing. One shared React Native/Hermes runtime renders Detail and Insights. The default transport is the same bundled replay comparison cell as the other current candidates.

android.uiToolkit: Jetpack Compose shell; React Native Fabric Detail and Insights islands
android.runtime: ART native shell plus one lazy or prewarmed Hermes runtime
android.streamClient: native in-app replay of the bundled, golden-verified stream; WebSocket not implemented

ios.uiToolkit: UIKit shell; React Native Fabric Detail and Insights islands
ios.runtime: Swift native shell plus one lazy or prewarmed Hermes runtime
ios.streamClient: native in-app replay of the bundled, golden-verified stream; WebSocket not implemented

R1.note: The Insights island is embedded in the installed artifact.

R2.reason: This candidate packages an embedded React Native island bundle; independently delivered island code is not implemented.

sync.note: Island markers and draw probes use a synchronous native forwarder; the bridge micro-benchmark is not implemented.

async.note: Host state snapshots and updates cross the Brownfield message channel; the bridge micro-benchmark is not implemented.

crossRuntime.boundary: native host owns data and navigation; React Native renders Detail and Insights from versioned JSON messages

deviations.description: The native host marker core and React Native forwarder are candidate-local interim instrumentation.
deviations.impact: Results remain descriptive until the shared calibrated BenchKit and overhead experiment exist.

deviations.description: The native host replays the same golden-verified bundled stream on the absolute monotonic schedule.
deviations.impact: It compares only inside replay transport cells and is never pooled with server transport.

deviations.description: Android consumes the packaged Brownfield AAR; the iOS simulator app links the same RN/Brownfield sources through CocoaPods while packaging support matures.
deviations.impact: Packaging strategy is platform-specific and recorded in build provenance.
